game_name: Fisherman's Bait - Marlin Challenge (GX889 VER. EA)
general_issues: Select a merged ROM ZIP and, where requested, a CHD from the game disc directory. Controls: Hold Reel Forward/Reverse for continuous reeling. Reel Switch is separate. Marlin Challenge uses Player 1 Joystick X/Y for its rod, with DirectInput keyboard/button axes enabled by default.
